_comment: Per-host policy and version assignment. max_parallel is POLICY (how many installs the host may run at once), independent of the hardware max_concurrent_vms capability preflight reports. Default 1. Coordinator (ugnomarchy) is the sole writer of this file.

ugnomarchy.status: installing mojave; also runs coordinator + mirror

omarchiMac.status: ready pending deps; single-VM by user request

og128x01.status: high-capacity (125GB); pre-Ventura only; blocked on clone approval + deps; max_parallel raisable on request

notes: AVX2 hosts (ugnomarchy, omarchiMac) are the ONLY ones that can run Ventura/Sonoma/Sequoia/Tahoe.
Pre-Ventura versions (High Sierra, Catalina, Big Sur, Monterey) can go to any host; prefer og128x01 for its capacity.
max_parallel defaults to 1 for the initial fan-out; raise per-host only when the user designates a machine for parallel installs.
